item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 02/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong moderating, the weather will be mild over the region today. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China on Monday morning. It will become cool with one or two rain patches over the region. The associated northeast monsoon will bring dry weather to Guangdong in the following couple of days. It will be cold in the morning over inland areas. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, the weather will remain cool and it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week.

PSR: Low
